d:
Jharkhand GST : jharkhand men rajasv barhane aur taiks chori par lagam lagane ke lie sarkar ne naee pahal ki hai. vanijy kar vibhag ki CT MIS pariyojna ke tahat Choice Consultancy Services Private Limited ke sath MoU kiya gaya hai.
Sarkar ka phokas GST sistam ko majbut karne, pharji rajistreshan par najar rakhne aur taiks likej rokne par hai. is pahal se kar prashasan ko behtar banane aur rajy ke rajasv sangrah ko majbut karne ki koshish ki ja rahi hai.
